user.title: Add vehicle
user.description: The vehicle and its battery. Only the state of charge has to come from an entity.

data_description.name: Leave empty to get a name assigned automatically.
data_description.soc_min_pct: Lower bound the plan always holds. Below it and plugged in, charging starts at once — without waiting for a good price.
data_description.soc_max_pct: Upper bound in normal operation. The plan only goes above it for a set target.
data_description.soc_entity: Sensor or helper carrying the state of charge in percent. Planning needs it — without a sensor, create an input_number helper.
data_description.station_id: The charge point this vehicle charges at.
data_description.plugged_entity: Optional binary_sensor. State on means plugged in; without it the vehicle counts as plugged in.
data_description.efficiency_pct: Total charging efficiency — cable, meter and onboard charger together.
